listNote: Official trophy names, descriptions and grades as published for PS5 (kit list dated 2026-11-18). 55 trophies: 1 Platinum, 2 Gold, 6 Silver, 46 Bronze. 28 are hidden (27 Bronze + 1 Gold). All 55 are offline and single-player; there are no online trophies. Hidden flags cross-checked on 2026-11-20 against PowerPyx, GTABase, GAMES.GG, Insider Gaming and EGamers, which all agree on 28 hidden. Every guide below is written in this entry's own words; each one cites at least two public sources. Exophase and PSNProfiles had no GTA VI trophy page when checked on 2026-11-20, so citations point to the live per-trophy guides that do exist.

roadmap.goal: Start the story, keep clean manual saves, and do not skip Lucia's balcony meditation.
roadmap.notes: GTA VI has no mission replay, no difficulty settings, and 15 manual save slots plus one autosave. Cheats disable trophies and saving, so keep them off for the whole run. The only trophy any guide flags as possibly missable is Positive Mental Attitude: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditating in the kitchen at Jason's house and walks to the balcony — follow her and accept. That moment is gone after Chapter 1, and whether the trophy truly needs it is still unconfirmed, so take it anyway and save. Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter.
roadmap.title: Chapter 1 and the one missable watch

roadmap.goal: Play Chapters 2-5 through to the final mission; story trophies unlock as you go and cannot be missed by playing.
roadmap.notes: Every chapter and named-mission trophy in this stage is earned simply by finishing that part of the story — there are no extra conditions and no gold-medal requirements. Because there is no mission replay, rotate your manual saves at chapter boundaries so a mistake never costs a full replay. Free roam continues after the credits, and progress earned during the story already counts toward the 100% checklist.
roadmap.title: Main story: chapters and named missions
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

roadmap.goal: Finish the side-character mission chains and the eight qualifying stranger strands.
roadmap.notes: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each end with a finale trophy, and Bret's hunt is its own trophy. For the Strangers & Freaks silver, only some strands count — guides name Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete among the qualifying ones, while Andy, Billy, Tyrone, Moses and Yasmani do not count toward the eight. Some stranger chains are tied to story progress, so work them as they appear instead of leaving every strand for the end.
roadmap.title: Stranger strands and character finales

roadmap.goal: Clear the activity-based trophies: stunts, shooting range golds, races, drone races, fishing, arcade, challenges.
roadmap.notes: Several activity trophies sit below the 100% targets, so keep going after they pop: 250 stunts for the trophy but 300 for 100%, 50 challenges for the trophy but any 70 of 80 for 100%, one drone-race win per location for the trophy but all 42 races for 100%. The Shootist (42 gold medals across 12 ranges) is the skill gate of this stage. Nothing here needs the story finished, so sprinkle these between missions whenever you pass a location.
roadmap.title: Activities and skill trophies

roadmap.goal: Rob vaults, trucks, shops and gang operations; bank the money trophies and buy the garages.
roadmap.notes: Bank-vault robberies open through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… and trigger a 4-star Wanted Level, which overlaps neatly with Hot Together. Escapes only count once you are out of the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. Reserve the roughly $160,000 for the eight purchasable garages before free spending, launder Marked Bills through contacts toward the $250,000 total, and keep both characters together for the two partner trophies.
roadmap.title: Crime, partner jobs and money

roadmap.goal: Finish card sets, WAiNK scans, vehicle discoveries and full-map exploration, then close out A Long Road and the Platinum.
roadmap.notes: After the credits the checklist lives at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. A Long Road asks for more than the standalone trophies: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations and 100 of 255 animals studied. Actions Speak Louder (500 Criminal Profile actions) usually fills naturally across the whole run — check it last. When the other 54 trophies are done, Vice Got a Price! unlocks.
roadmap.title: Collectibles, exploration and the 100% cleanup

trophies.guide: This is the Platinum: it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. Everything in the list is offline and single-player, there are no difficulty settings to worry about, and one playthrough is enough because free roam continues after the story. Guides put the full run at roughly 200 hours, with most of that time inside the 100% checklist behind A Long Road.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Earn all 54 other trophies in any order that suits your run.
Protect the one possibly-missable moment early: Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude).
Keep cheats off for the entire run — using one disables trophies and saving.
Use this tracker's roadmap stages to order the work, then finish with the Stage 6 cleanup.
tips: Rotate manual saves at chapter boundaries; there is no mission replay if something goes wrong.
Check the in-game Progress > Stats > 100% Completion screen after the credits to see exactly what remains.

trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission of the game. It is hidden so the mission name does not spoil the start, but there is nothing extra to do: play the mission to its end and the trophy pops. Story trophies like this one cannot be missed because the campaign cannot be finished without them.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Follow the on-screen objectives to the end of the mission.
The trophy unlocks as the mission completes.
tips: Make your first manual save right after this mission so you always have a clean Chapter 1 anchor save.

trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 1 of the story. Before you cross into Chapter 2, use the chapter to grab the one moment guides flag as possibly missable: the morning after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house, follow her to the balcony when she mentions meditating, and accept. Whether that meditation is required for Positive Mental Attitude is still unconfirmed, but it disappears after this chapter, so do it while you are here.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Play Chapter 1's main missions in order.
After Down to Earth, visit Jason's house in the morning and accept Lucia's balcony meditation.
Finish the chapter's final mission to unlock this trophy.
Save manually at the chapter boundary before moving on.
tips: Keep a dedicated save slot at the end of Chapter 1 — with no mission replay, chapter-boundary saves are your only safety net.

trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 2. Two useful unlocks land during this chapter: garage purchases open through the Vice City Real Estate phone app after Daily Driver (needed for Little Boxes), and the Scooter Bros app arrives with the Moses mission (needed for On the Spot). Play the chapter through and the trophy is yours — story progress alone earns it.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Play Chapter 2's main missions to the chapter finale.
After Daily Driver, note that garage buying is now available in the Vice City Real Estate app.
After the Moses mission, note that vehicle registration is now available in the Scooter Bros app.
Finish the chapter to unlock the trophy, then save manually.
tips: Start reserving cash for the eight purchasable garages (about $160,000 in total) instead of spending freely.

trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 3. This chapter matters beyond the story: finishing Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs unlocks the Snap Gun, the quiet way into a jewelry store's back door that Sneakthief depends on. Chapter 3 progress also widens vehicle registration to Standard Tracker vehicles and Pay 'n' Spray locations. Finish the chapter and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Play Chapter 3's main missions to the chapter finale.
Complete Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun for later stealth robberies.
Finish the chapter to unlock the trophy, then save manually.
tips: Once you have the Snap Gun, a jewelry-store robbery can be done without tripping the alarm — see Sneakthief.

trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 4. Watch for the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… during this chapter: it opens up Large Bank Vault robberies, which feed both Maximum Withdrawal and the 100% checklist. Complete the chapter's story missions and this trophy unlocks on its own.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Play Chapter 4's main missions to the chapter finale.
Take the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… when it appears to unlock bank-vault robberies.
Finish the chapter to unlock the trophy, then save manually.
tips: Bank-vault runs trigger a 4-star Wanted Level, so they pair naturally with Hot Together later.

trophies.guide: The story's Gold trophy, earned by completing the final mission of the campaign. It is one of only two Gold trophies in the list and the only hidden Gold. Finishing the story does not lock anything away: free roam continues afterwards, the 100% checklist becomes visible at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and everything earned earlier already counts.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Play the campaign through Chapter 5 to the final mission.
Complete the final mission to unlock the trophy.
After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to plan the cleanup stages.
tips: Keep a manual save just before the finale; with no mission replay, it is cheap insurance.

trophies.guide: A hidden story trophy for finishing the named mission Breakfast Run. Like the other named-mission trophies, it needs no extra condition: reach the mission in the campaign, play it to completion, and the trophy unlocks. It stays hidden in the trophy list until earned so the mission name is not spoiled early.
trophies.name: Trust

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Progress the story until the mission Breakfast Run becomes available.
Play the mission through to its completion.
The trophy unlocks when the mission ends.
tips: Named-mission trophies are unmissable — if you finished the story, you earned every one of them.

trophies.guide: A hidden story trophy for finishing the named mission The Cartel Heist. Play the mission when the campaign offers it and complete it; no side condition is attached. Because the story cannot be completed without its missions, this trophy cannot be missed on a normal playthrough.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Progress the story until The Cartel Heist becomes available.
Complete the mission's objectives to the end.
The trophy unlocks on completion.
tips: Heist-style missions are good moments to refresh your manual save before starting.

trophies.guide: A hidden story trophy for finishing the named mission Child's Play. It unlocks automatically when the mission is completed during the campaign; there is no extra requirement to track and no way to miss it while finishing the story.
trophies.name: Family Matters

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Progress the story until Child's Play becomes available.
Play the mission to completion.
The trophy unlocks when the mission ends.
tips: If a named-mission trophy seems missing, check that the mission itself shows as completed in your progress screens.

trophies.guide: A hidden story trophy for finishing the named mission Headliners. Complete the mission when the campaign reaches it and the trophy pops — no additional condition, no collectible, no time limit is attached in any published list.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Progress the story until Headliners becomes available.
Complete the mission.
The trophy unlocks on completion.
tips: Story trophies are hidden only to avoid spoilers; the spoiler shield in this tracker mirrors that behaviour.

trophies.guide: A hidden story trophy for finishing the named mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. Complete the mission during the campaign and the trophy unlocks. Do not confuse it with Catch Me If You Can, the separate free-roam trophy for stealing a passenger plane at VCIA.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Progress the story until VCIA Takedown becomes available.
Complete the mission's objectives.
The trophy unlocks when the mission ends.
tips: While you are at VCIA for the story, note the terminal layout — it helps later for Catch Me If You Can.

trophies.guide: A hidden story trophy for finishing the named mission Operation Savage Glory. As with every named-mission trophy in this list, completing the mission is the whole requirement, and finishing the campaign guarantees it.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Progress the story until Operation Savage Glory becomes available.
Complete the mission.
The trophy unlocks on completion.
tips: Save manually before long operations so a failed attempt never costs more than a reload.

trophies.guide: The Gold trophy for reaching 100% completion, widely reported as the hardest in the set. The checklist appears at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story, but everything you did earlier already counts. It asks for more than the standalone trophies: 300 stunts (trophy at 250), any 70 of 80 challenges (trophy at 50), 200 of 277 vehicles scanned (trophy at 100 discovered), all 8 bank vaults (trophy at 5), all 39 gang operations (trophy at one per gang) and 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars. Work the checklist in free roam after the credits.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Clear the remaining robberies, bank vaults and gang operations.
Push the long counters past their trophy thresholds: 300 stunts, 70 challenges, 200 vehicle scans.
Study 100 animals with binoculars while exploring; dog and cat breeds count separately.
Finish shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's Target Decks as listed.
tips: Nothing on the 100% checklist is reported missable, so this stage is safe to leave for post-story cleanup.
Keep going after each standalone trophy pops — its counter usually feeds a higher 100% target.

trophies.guide: A Silver trophy for completing 250 stunts. Guides report 397 stunts in total, and the four kinds — Stunt Jumps, Under the Bridges, Knife Flights and Base Jumps — can be mixed freely, so pick whichever categories you find easiest instead of clearing one kind completely. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep stunt-hunting after this trophy pops.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Open your progress screens to see which stunt categories you have started.
Complete stunts across any mix of Stunt Jumps, Under the Bridges, Knife Flights and Base Jumps.
Reach 250 completed stunts to unlock the trophy.
Continue to 300 if you are chasing A Long Road.
tips: Do stunts opportunistically while travelling between other objectives; the count adds up fast.
A failed stunt costs nothing but time — retry immediately while the setup is fresh.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types in Leonida at least once. You do not need to win or master anything — starting and completing one round of every activity category is enough. It overlaps naturally with the other activity trophies, so by the time you have sampled races, drone races, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games and the rest, this one is usually already done.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: List the nine activity types from your in-game progress screens.
Start and complete one session of each type.
The trophy unlocks when the ninth distinct type is tried.
tips: Use this trophy as a tour: one attempt at everything also reveals which activities you enjoy for the longer grinds.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: A Silver trophy for earning a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 gold medals spread across 12 ranges, according to published guides. This is the pure-skill gate of the activity stage: each challenge can be retried immediately, so work one range at a time and learn its target patterns before moving on. All 42 golds are also part of the road to 100% completion.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Visit each of the 12 shooting ranges and open its challenge list.
Earn the gold medal in every challenge at that range, retrying as needed.
Repeat until all 42 gold medals are banked.
The trophy unlocks with the final gold.
tips: Short, focused sessions beat one long grind — accuracy drops when you are tired.
If a challenge stalls, move to another range and come back with fresh eyes.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough for the trophy; the 100% checklist asks for all 42 drone races, so expect to return to these spots during cleanup. Track locations in this guide's checklist as you clear them so none is forgotten.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Find a Top Fun Drone Race location and enter the race.
Win the race — a single win at that location counts for the trophy.
Repeat at all 14 locations.
The trophy unlocks with the fourteenth location win.
tips: Learn each course once at a relaxed pace; a clean line usually beats raw speed.
Note which locations still need their other races for the 42-race 100% target.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The word different is the catch: guides report 40 races in total, and winning the same race twice does not advance the counter. Keep a simple list of which races you have already won — this tracker's notes habit works — and always pick a fresh event until you reach twenty distinct wins.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Enter a race event and win it.
Record which race it was so you do not repeat it for this trophy.
Win 19 more distinct races, for 20 different wins in total.
The trophy unlocks on the twentieth distinct win.
tips: If the counter seems stuck, you are probably re-winning a race you already cleared.
Racing also feeds your cash reserves for the garage and spending trophies.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of Leonida's activity types, so this trophy doubles as progress toward Master of None. Enter Cal's challenge when you meet him, out-fish him under the challenge rules, and the trophy is yours; if you lose, the challenge can simply be tried again.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Meet Cal and accept his fishing challenge.
Fish under the challenge's rules until the result is decided.
Beat Cal's result to unlock the trophy.
Retry the challenge if the first attempt goes his way.
tips: Treat the first attempt as practice for the spot's timing and fish behaviour.

trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game from start to finish. It does not matter which cabinet or how well you score — finishing a full game is the requirement. Arcade play also counts as one of the activity types for Master of None, so this is a quick two-for-one early in the activity stage.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Find an arcade cabinet in Leonida.
Start a game and play it through to completion.
The trophy unlocks when the game ends.
tips: Pick the shortest game you can find if you only want the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy for completing Andy's final mission — the last entry in his side-mission chain. Work Andy's missions as they appear during the story and finish the chain; the trophy unlocks at the finale. Note that Andy's strand does not count toward the eight qualifying strands of Strangers & Freaks, so this trophy stands on its own.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Meet Andy and complete his side missions as they unlock.
Continue the chain until his final mission is offered.
Complete the final mission to unlock the trophy.
tips: Side chains can be tied to story progress — do not leave every strand until after the credits.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy for completing Kenton's final mission, the end of his side-mission chain. Follow Kenton's missions through the story and finish the last one; the trophy unlocks on completion. Like the other character finales, it is earned by finishing the chain, not by any extra condition.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Meet Kenton and complete his side missions as they unlock.
Continue until his final mission is offered.
Complete the final mission to unlock the trophy.
tips: Keep a manual save before a chain finale in case you want to revisit a choice.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy for completing Billy's final mission, closing out his side-mission chain. Play Billy's missions as they appear and finish the finale to unlock it. Billy's strand is one of those that does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so treat this as a standalone character trophy.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Meet Billy and complete his side missions as they unlock.
Continue the chain to his final mission.
Complete the final mission to unlock the trophy.
tips: Tick each character chain off in this tracker as you finish it — five finales are easy to lose track of.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: A Silver trophy for completing eight stranger mission strands across Leonida. The trap is that not every side chain counts: guides name Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete among the qualifying strands, while Andy, Billy, Tyrone, Moses and Yasmani do not count toward the eight. Use the trophy's own tracker in your progress screens to count qualifying strands instead of assuming every finished chain advanced it.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Meet strangers across Leonida and start their mission strands.
Complete each strand fully, from first meeting to finale.
Check the trophy tracker to confirm which strands counted.
Reach eight qualifying completed strands to unlock the trophy.
tips: Do strands as they appear — some chains are tied to story progress windows.
The five character-finale trophies are separate; finishing them does not guarantee this counter moved.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy for completing Randy's final mission, the last link in his side-mission chain. Work through Randy's missions during the story and finish the finale; the trophy unlocks on completion with no further conditions.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Meet Randy and complete his side missions as they unlock.
Continue the chain until his final mission is offered.
Complete the final mission to unlock the trophy.
tips: If a chain seems to stall, advance the main story — later links often unlock with chapter progress.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy for completing Tyrone's final mission, closing his side-mission chain. Finish Tyrone's missions as they appear and complete the finale to unlock it. Tyrone's strand does not count toward the eight strands of Strangers & Freaks, so this trophy is tracked separately.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Meet Tyrone and complete his side missions as they unlock.
Continue the chain to his final mission.
Complete the final mission to unlock the trophy.
tips: Character finales are quick wins during Stage 3 — clear them before the long activity grinds.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida — 18 spots across 10 locations, tracked under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. Meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts twice toward the 18, and the last one needs both characters together, which becomes possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. The catch, flagged by both PowerPyx and GTABase, is the first meditation: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen at Jason's house and walks to the balcony — follow her and choose Accept. It raises the counter by one but is not marked like the other spots, and it is gone after Chapter 1; whether the trophy strictly needs it is still unconfirmed, so take it and keep a save.
trophies.missableNote: Potentially missable (unconfirmed): the first meditation is Lucia's balcony session at Jason's house in Chapter 1, which disappears after the chapter ends. Guides are not yet certain the trophy requires it, so do it to be safe.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Chapter 1: after Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning.
Follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation invitation.
Save manually, then continue the story.
Visit the meditation spots across Leonida and meditate with both characters where possible.
Track the counter at Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations until it reaches 18.
tips: Do the balcony meditation even though its necessity is unconfirmed — missing it may cost a full replay, doing it costs a minute.
Pair meditation spots with nearby WAiNK scans and vehicle discoveries to save travel.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy for hunting a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting work (his Target Decks also appear on the 100% checklist) gives you specific quarry rather than free hunting: take his request, track the named animal in the wild, and complete the hunt as instructed. Finishing that unique hunt unlocks the trophy.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Meet Bret and accept his hunting request.
Track the unique animal he names.
Complete the hunt as instructed to unlock the trophy.
tips: While hunting, study other animals through binoculars — 100 studied animals feed the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: A Silver trophy for completing three Collectible Card sets. Cards are a pure collectible grind: find the cards scattered across Leonida, keep track of which sets are nearly complete, and finish any three full sets. Because sets are what count — not total cards — focus your hunting on completing sets rather than grabbing cards at random.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Collect cards as you explore Leonida.
Check your collection screens to see which sets are closest to complete.
Hunt the missing cards for those sets first.
Complete three full sets to unlock the trophy.
tips: Keep card hunting separate from WAiNK scanning in your notes; the two collectible systems are tracked independently.

trophies.guide: A Silver trophy for using WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida. WAiNK scanning is an environmental collectible: when you reach a scannable location, use the WAiNK function and the counter rises. One hundred scans is a long tail, so scan opportunistically whenever you pass a new place instead of saving it all for one cleanup session. Vehicle scanning is a separate objective — do not confuse the two counters.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Use WAiNK It whenever you arrive at a new location or landmark.
Check the counter in your progress screens regularly.
Reach 100 scanned locations to unlock the trophy.
tips: Combine WAiNK scans with meditation spots, card pickups and vehicle discoveries on the same trips.
If the counter stalls, you may be scanning vehicles instead of locations — they are counted separately.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 challenges in total, and the 100% checklist wants any 70 of them, so this trophy is a milestone on a longer road rather than the end of it. Pick the challenges that match what you are already doing — driving, combat, exploration — and let the counter fill across the whole run instead of grinding them in one block.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Open the Challenges list in your progress screens.
Complete challenges in any order; 50 completions unlock the trophy.
Continue toward 70 of 80 if you are chasing A Long Road.
tips: Many challenges complete naturally during story missions and robberies — check the list before grinding anything specific.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With both characters together, reach a 4-star Wanted Level and then lose it completely. Clearing the flashing search area is not enough — you must also escape the red heat zone before the trophy counts. Bank-vault robberies are a natural setup because they trigger 4 stars on their own; bring your partner, grab the cash, and run. Guides suggest the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County as cover from helicopters during the escape.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Bring both characters together (partner present).
Raise your Wanted Level to 4 stars — a bank-vault robbery does this reliably.
Break line of sight and leave the flashing search area.
Keep going until you are fully out of the red heat zone and the stars clear.
tips: Plan the escape route before the crime; tunnels and covered ground break helicopter pursuit.
If the trophy does not pop, you probably left the search area but not the heat zone.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner while keeping your Wanted Level active the whole time — the opposite of Hot Together. The flashing pursuit must stay live between shops; merely standing in the red heat zone without an active Wanted Level does not satisfy the condition. Pick three shops close together, move fast between them, and do not panic if the trophy takes about 30 seconds after leaving the final shop to appear.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Bring your partner and choose three shops near each other.
Rob the first shop to raise your Wanted Level.
Move straight to the second and third shops, robbing each without letting the stars clear.
After the third shop, wait a short while — the unlock can be delayed.
tips: Scout the route first; losing the Wanted Level between shops resets the streak.
Stay visible enough to keep the pursuit active, but keep moving so you are not cornered.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Discovery is about encountering and registering distinct vehicles as you explore, not about owning them. The 100% checklist raises the bar to scanning 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, so keep discovering new models after this trophy pops. Vary your neighbourhoods — different districts spawn different traffic, which is the fastest way to meet models you have not seen.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Explore different districts of Leonida to encounter varied traffic.
Discover each new vehicle model you come across.
Reach 100 discovered vehicles to unlock the trophy.
Continue toward 200 scanned vehicles for A Long Road.
tips: Parking areas and showrooms concentrate many models in one place.
Do not confuse vehicle discovery with WAiNK location scans — separate counters.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during a single activation of Combat Focus. While aiming a firearm, press L3 + R3 to trigger the focus state, then work through a clustered group before the bar drains. An assault rifle helps you move between targets quickly, and Adrenaline extends the duration if you need more time. Gang operations are ideal hunting grounds because enemies arrive in groups.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Find a group of at least five enemies, such as at a gang operation.
Aim your firearm and press L3 + R3 to activate Combat Focus.
Take down five enemies before the focus bar empties.
Use Adrenaline to extend the window if you run short.
tips: Position yourself so all five targets are visible without big camera swings.
Save manually before the attempt so a near-miss costs only a reload.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy for making an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). Guides report it needs a large passenger plane connected to a boarding bridge — the aircraft at terminals E3/E4 is a suitable choice — not just any plane parked on the airfield. Board it, head upstairs to the cockpit, reverse toward the runway, take off, and fly about 1 km away from the airport; the unlock can be delayed until you are clear.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Go to VCIA and find a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge (terminals E3/E4).
Enter the plane and go upstairs to the cockpit.
Reverse out toward the runway and take off.
Fly roughly 1 km from the airport and wait for the delayed unlock.
tips: A plane parked away from a bridge reportedly does not count — use the docked aircraft.
Do not land again immediately; distance from the airport is part of the trigger.

trophies.guide: A hidden trophy with a deliberately cryptic description pointing at Rhino tanks. As of 20 November 2026, published guides still list its exact trigger as unconfirmed, so this entry is honest about that: the description ties it to getting into or dealing with a Rhino (tank) in free roam. When you find a Rhino, interact with it — enter and drive it — and watch for the unlock; check the cited guides for updates as the method gets confirmed.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Locate a Rhino tank in free roam (military or high-heat contexts are the natural places to look).
Enter and drive the Rhino.
If nothing unlocks, check the cited sources — the precise trigger was still unconfirmed at writing.
tips: Save before experimenting with a Rhino; high Wanted Levels around military hardware escalate fast.
Treat any specific method you see elsewhere with care until two guides agree on it.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The quiet route opens after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun: use it on the store's locked back door, find the safe-code note inside, and open the safe without raising the alarm. Kicking the door in triggers the alarm and ruins the attempt. Guides name Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City as a suitable target.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to unlock the Snap Gun.
Go to a jewelry store (for example Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City).
Use the Snap Gun on the locked back door instead of forcing it.
Find the safe-code note inside and open the safe quietly.
Leave without being detected.
tips: If the alarm sounds, reload your manual save and try the quiet route again.
Scout the back-door approach in daylight first so the night run is familiar.

trophies.guide: A Silver trophy for robbing five bank vaults and escaping each time. Large Bank Vault robberies unlock through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…: follow the security van to a bank and slip in while the guard has the vault open. Bring your partner — one character cannot carry all the cash bags alone. Each robbery triggers a 4-star Wanted Level, and the escape only counts once you are out of the red heat zone. There are eight vaults in total and 100% completion wants all of them.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Unlock vault robberies via the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….
Follow a security van to its bank and enter while the guard has the vault open.
Bring your partner to carry all the cash bags.
Escape fully out of the red heat zone.
Repeat at five different vaults (all eight for A Long Road).
tips: Combine the first vault run with Hot Together — the 4-star escape satisfies both.
Plan covered escape routes; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a reported safe line.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop the truck, take its cash, and then get properly away: like the other escape trophies, clearing the flashing search area is not enough — you must leave the red heat zone as well before it counts. Armored trucks appear in free roam, so keep an eye out while travelling and strike when you have a clean escape route.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Spot an armored truck in free roam and intercept it.
Rob the truck and take the cash.
Break pursuit and exit the red heat zone completely.
The trophy unlocks once the escape registers.
tips: Choose your ground: a truck stopped near tunnels or covered roads is far easier to escape from.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — every area of the state (the kit list counts 52 areas). This is a coverage trophy: systematically visit each region instead of only travelling between mission markers. It pairs naturally with the other exploration work — WAiNK scans, meditation spots, vehicle discoveries and animal studying all pull you into corners of the map you would otherwise never visit.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Travel deliberately into every region of Leonida, not just mission destinations.
Use your map and progress screens to spot unvisited areas.
Combine exploration trips with WAiNK scans, cards and vehicle discoveries.
The trophy unlocks when the final area is explored.
tips: Roads, coasts and back-country tracks each reveal different areas — vary your routes.
Leave a dedicated exploration sweep for Stage 6 cleanup if a few areas remain.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. One operation per gang is enough for the trophy, but there are 39 operations in total and the 100% checklist wants every one, so expect to keep raiding long after this pops. Gang operations are also prime spots for Gunslinger, since enemies cluster there. Track which gangs you have hit so the ninth does not become a guessing game.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Find an illegal operation and identify which gang owns it.
Rob the operation and escape.
Record the gang as done in your tracker notes.
Repeat until all nine gangs have been robbed once.
Continue toward all 39 operations for A Long Road.
tips: Bring your best weapons and armour; operations are defended.
If the counter seems stuck, you are probably re-robbing a gang you already cleared.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy for enjoying a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The description is the method: find a spot on Ocean Beach where you can have a cocktail overlooking the water and take the moment. As of 20 November 2026, guides still list the precise spot among the not-yet-confirmed secrets, so explore Ocean Beach's bars and viewpoints, interact where a drink is offered, and check the cited sources for the confirmed location as guides update.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Travel to Ocean Beach in Vice City.
Look for a bar or viewpoint spot offering a cocktail with an ocean view.
Take the drink and enjoy the view to trigger the trophy.
If it does not trigger, check the cited guides — the exact spot was unconfirmed at writing.
tips: Sunset hours are a sensible time to try a 'with a view' moment.
Keep a save before experimenting so trying spots costs nothing.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy for smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. In plain terms: get into a vehicle inside a showroom and drive it out through the showroom's glass or entrance rather than using the door like a customer. Vehicle showrooms also concentrate many car models in one place, so the visit doubles as vehicle-discovery progress for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Find a vehicle showroom with cars on display inside.
Get into one of the display vehicles.
Drive it out by smashing through the showroom frontage.
The trophy unlocks on the dramatic exit.
tips: Expect police attention afterwards — have an escape direction in mind.
Save first; showroom layouts vary and the first attempt may not register.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy tied to the bowling alley. Guides place the action at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn: steal all three key valuables inside — the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table, and the contents of the safe in the northeast hallway office (bring Sticky Bombs for the safe) — then escape the police. Killing the enemies inside is not required, and valuables collected on an earlier visit still count if you return later.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn with Sticky Bombs in your inventory.
Take the luxury watch from the southeast office.
Take the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun from the northeast table.
Open the safe in the northeast hallway office and take its contents.
Escape the police to finish the robbery.
tips: If you miss a valuable, you can return on a later visit — earlier pickups still count.
Do not waste time clearing every enemy; the valuables are the objective.

trophies.guide: A hidden trophy whose description hints at the partnership. Guides report the requirement is reaching maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia. Visit fitness clubs together so the partner you are not controlling trains alongside you, and keep both characters' Strength climbing until both are maxed. Training in pairs is faster than levelling each character separately.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Take both characters to a fitness club together.
Train the character you control; the partner trains alongside.
Swap characters and repeat until both have maximum Strength.
The trophy unlocks when the second character maxes out.
tips: Check both Strength stats in your progress screens so neither character lags behind.
Fold training sessions into trips you are already making past a gym.

trophies.guide: A hidden trophy for making choices — specifically, 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Robberies and enemy encounters feed the counter naturally, so most players finish it without a dedicated grind; guides advise leaving it until other jobs are done and only grinding the remainder if it is still short. It is not missable: the counter keeps rising in free roam after the story. One warning from the guides — the Irredeemable criminal profile is permanent, so think before pushing your profile to the extreme.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Play normally: robberies and enemy encounters raise the Criminal Profile action counter.
Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in settings to watch each change register.
Check the trophy in your list to track progress toward 500.
If short at the end, keep committing profile-affecting actions in free roam until it fills.
tips: Do not grind this early — a full trophy run usually fills most of the 500 on its own.
Beware the permanent Irredeemable profile state; save before experimenting at the extremes.

trophies.guide: A hidden trophy with a cryptic description: 'Second time's the charm.' The plain reading is that it rewards succeeding at something on a second attempt after a first failure. As of 20 November 2026, guides still list the exact trigger among the unconfirmed secrets, so this entry does not invent one: when an activity or encounter lets you retry after failing, take the retry and succeed, and check the cited sources as the confirmed method is published.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: When you fail an attempt at an activity or encounter that offers a retry, accept the retry.
Succeed on the second attempt.
If no unlock follows, check the cited guides — the precise trigger was unconfirmed at writing.
tips: Do not reload a save after a first failure if you are hunting this trophy — the retry is the point.
Keep this one on your watch-list during Stage 4 activities, where retries are constant.

trophies.guide: A hidden trophy for witnessing something strange — the description ('What the hell just happened?') points to a one-off weird event somewhere in Leonida rather than a repeatable activity. As of 20 November 2026, guides still list its exact trigger as unconfirmed, so this guide stays honest: explore the state's odd corners during your Stage 6 sweep, investigate anything that looks like a staged strange event, and check the cited sources for the confirmed location as guides update.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Explore remote and unusual corners of Leonida during free roam.
Investigate any staged or out-of-place event you find.
Witness the event to its end.
Check the cited guides for the confirmed trigger — it was unconfirmed at writing.
tips: Pair this hunt with The Goodtime State exploration so no region goes unvisited.
Strange events are often time- or place-specific; note where and when you saw anything odd.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy for bowling someone over with a melee drive-by: from a moving vehicle, lean out and strike a person with a melee attack so they are knocked down. It is a one-action trophy — line up a pedestrian at the roadside, swing as you pass, and the knockdown should register. Despite the bowling pun in the name, it has nothing to do with the bowling alley trophy.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Drive along a road with pedestrians at the kerb.
As you pass a person, perform a melee drive-by strike from the vehicle.
Knock the person over to unlock the trophy.
tips: Moderate speed gives you time to line the swing up; full speed usually overshoots.
Expect a small Wanted Level afterwards — drive on and let it fade.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from criminal work such as robberies; instead of spending them raw, pass them through your contacts to convert them into clean earnings, and keep going until the laundered total reaches $250,000. It is a cumulative money trophy, so every robbery in Stage 5 feeds it — check the counter periodically rather than grinding it in one sitting.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Earn Marked Bills through robberies and other criminal work.
Take them to your contacts and launder them into clean money.
Repeat until your cumulative laundered earnings reach $250,000.
The trophy unlocks at the $250,000 mark.
tips: Launder regularly instead of hoarding — it keeps cash flowing toward the garage purchases.
Bank-vault hauls are the biggest single source; pair the two grinds.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. Every purchase counts toward the cumulative total, so normal play — clothes, haircuts, tattoos, gear — chips away at it. Plan the order of your spending: guides advise reserving roughly $160,000 for the eight purchasable garages (Little Boxes) before free spending, then letting shop purchases carry you over $100,000 without starving the garage fund.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Buy items across Leonida's shops as you play; all spending counts cumulatively.
Reserve the garage money first (about $160,000) so Little Boxes is never blocked.
Keep spending until your shop total reaches $100,000.
The trophy unlocks at the $100,000 mark.
tips: Big-ticket shop items close the gap fastest once the garage fund is safe.
This trophy usually completes on its own during a full run — check before grinding it.

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — the eight purchasable garages (the four story garages do not need buying). Garage purchases become available through the Vice City Real Estate phone app after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, and the eight together cost about $160,000, so reserve that money before spending freely. Extra parking also helps On the Spot, which needs room to register vehicles.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Reach Chapter 2's Daily Driver mission to unlock garage purchases.
Open the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone.
Buy each of the eight purchasable garages (about $160,000 in total).
The trophy unlocks with the eighth purchase.
tips: Save the $160,000 before Treat Yo Self spending so this trophy is never cash-blocked.
Buy garages as cash allows; there is no benefit to waiting for all eight at once.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app unlocks through the Chapter 2 mission Moses: take an eligible stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register. Cheap cars and bikes keep the registration costs down. At first Moses only accepts vehicles without trackers; later Chapter 3 progress also allows Standard Tracker vehicles and registration at Pay 'n' Spray locations. You will need enough garage space, which ties this trophy to Little Boxes.
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Complete the Chapter 2 mission Moses to unlock the Scooter Bros app.
Take an eligible vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn.
Choose Respray, then Register.
Repeat until 10 vehicles are registered.
After Chapter 3 progress, Pay 'n' Spray locations can also register vehicles.
tips: Use cheap cars and bikes — registration cost scales with the vehicle.
Buy garage space first (Little Boxes) so registered vehicles have somewhere to live.
